title: Business Discovery Source Registry
source_quality_rules: Do not fabricate sources, URLs, publication dates, or supporting claims.
Prefer primary sources for technical specifications and authoritative requirements.
Record when a source supports a general principle rather than a mandatory requirement.
Check whether the source is current and applicable to the project context.
Do not treat customer statements as independently verified external evidence.
Record conflicting evidence for review instead of silently choosing a source.
note: An empty source registry means no external source has yet been registered for this layer. Populate it as claims requiring external evidence are introduced.
